exposure: change in the presentation of the second twin between the most recent antepartum ultrasonogram and the ultrasonogram done on admission to labor and delivery
outcome: intrapartum presentation change of the second twin
cohort: 450 women with viable vertex-vertex twin pregnancies who delivered the presenting twin vaginally
finding: Multiparity and gestational age less than 34 weeks were significantly associated with an increased risk of intrapartum presentation change of the second twin, leading to a higher rate of cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Intrapartum presentation change of the second twin was associated with a higher rate of cesarean deliveries.
gest_age: Less than 34 weeks gestation was associated with intrapartum presentation change.
